notes.title: The biggest discount on all games in support of Chinese players
notes.notes:

notes.title: Major "Catch a Lover" update + Nightmare DLC Release!
notes.notes:
We know how many of you have been waiting for this for a long time, and finally it happened! We have released our biggest update for the original game, and for true fans of the game we have released DLC that will immerse you in the worst nightmare of the Lover. 
And now let's talk about everything in more detail and in order. 
[h1][i][b]List of changes for update:[/b][/i][/h1]
- The appearance of the maps and their lightning has been completely redone.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/1ce92fa7cc6ee7312a8efe72141c4e00cf149129.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/074dfc7f2b12433ea5f857922458fc6392103011.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/20fcc1f41671af415618df8107d6ac7584a77e3b.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/601f5ccf14b08c0d982051599a4aaf3a5db93237.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/04f15bf58db7f66303aada81fe9b6d8cdbc33345.gif[/img]
- All movement animations are changed.
- The wife is tired to endure the humiliation of her loser husband, and now she can beat him with a frying pan
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/70f3da462765809e86babe45b1076c15cc7a55f2.png[/img]
- Added water pistol, its purpose you have to find out by yourself
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/3c36f18b76fe8159adc2ff5ccc4a8728f0c53723.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/43badeece9da0f46eb4404c79fc9ad406514fcb0.jpg[/img][/url]
- All characters now have sprint [Shift] and walking [Ctrl]
- Husband can now break doors
- Hundreds of minor fixes and improvements

[h1][i][b]Catch a Lover: Nightmare DLC[/b][/i][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/03d9f11b84792a886fe0cf38d3580591110b87a0.png[/img]
For a small price you will get access to the dark and atmospheric version of one of the houses of the original game, as well as to two completely new characters. The goal is still the same - to track down and to defeat a lover.
Here are some screenshots:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/64ca4964a373cd90e65e817b79898b15a73d5762.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/8d73be44b5a9c10ed53fd790c2d217b74025de4c.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/f21fb820600549eebccb9e5f90d54dae5845d05f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/6632df1b025f38580073e4edec51095ea631d4c3.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/2f818c9bf13f026702a5b2a0f4c8ace1a5c98000.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/cb9bb864c9883587f9699528af00a024e815d196.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/39a89062a7985ca41ce88285a9cfdfdeb58f0ced.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/2054ce132eae9ba5700ab1076c1592f002dba611.png[/img][/url]

Play, write reviews, offer your ideas on how to improve the game, for example in the Steam discussion or our [url=https://discord.gg/DP8dCBW]Discord[/url].
We will be glad to all!

notes.title: What awaits Catch a Lover in the near future? Huge game update and game DLC
notes.notes:
It's been almost a year since the release of Catch a Lover. For this year, we have gained more experience in working with Unreal Engine, working on several other projects. Now it's time to tell you about the future of our game, what changes await the original game, and what our DLC will contain.

We read all the reviews and discussions on the game, we listen and try to solve the main problems that are now present in Catch a Lover.

Regarding the original game - it will be significantly improved in technical and visual terms and the update will be released with the release of DLC.
We spent a lot of time and money on improving character animations, as well as improving the appearance of the game. In the game settings will be added an alternative view, making graphics more cartoonish
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/14d490b03a9d7262b151cb5ee06a6f7cda43901d.jpg[/img]

We have purchased an excellent plugin for unreal engine, that will make game searching more convenient, and connection to the server will be more reliable. Also we added a lot of effects of blood, water and fire.

We made brand new footstep sounds, that must be more realistic. The sound of footsteps will depend on whether you are running or stealing, and on what surface are you standing.

We are not sure, but we are thinking about removing first person camera, write us what are you thinking about it!
Want to find people to play with? Or you have any suggestions? Join Our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DP8dCBW]Discord![/url]

In DLC there will be two new characters who will fight against the lover and the wife:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/256e1a8a9066a6e705412959689cdc94dc099063.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/523f3f27117a742b803587067d91e451442ba083.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/8042b62f3439c8f2a1cc63da3656e1450a115d44.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/95cc106fdcbee2938084aab1b125412475ae3e83.jpg[/img][/url]

Gradually we will tell you about the innovations in the original game and DLC, but for now go to our page in Steam and add "Nightmare" to your wishlist!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/f03ceb93d52a7b5c2bcf6e2883cb629287f371d4.png[/img]

notes.title: Early access, huge update, giveaway and launch discount.
notes.notes:
Hello! We thought for a long time, and decided that we should remove the "Early Access" mark from our game. Of course, we understand that its development is still far from complete, we know that players have a few technical problems, many players complain about the behavior of the camera of the first person. We don’t even think about stopping work on the game, constant updates and improvements will come out, but there will already be a full-fledged game released from early access. For 4 months, much of the game has changed, much has been added and improved, more things we had to completely remake. Now most of the complaints from the players come from the lack of online play. I want to remind you that originally the game was conceived for fun in the company of friends, but we understand that it is not always possible to get together and play together.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/e0c03afd288e59b47f2f515f6fb4984d732c9e34.png[/img]

In order to slightly increase online, and also in honor of the release of the game from early access, we launch a [url=http://www.indiedb.com/giveaways/catch-a-lover-release]giveaway[/url] on the indieDB, and also launch a sale in the Steam with a generous 30% discount.
Also we shot a small funny trailer for the game, you can watch it on [url=https://youtu.be/6WKQyxpV9y0]YouTube[/url], or on the store page.

Some information about the big update, which we prepared for the release of the game:
- We added a huge bunch of decorative caps for all our characters. These items are scattered across all two maps, some are very simple to find, some harder, and some were hidden from your view very reliably. Collect a complete collection of hats, but remember, only one player can take the same hat per session.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/f5f690202f73d3b11b0d5a9755285cdd1fe32d3b.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/8d734ca83c7af8c0bf2abf47f4257ece236510fc.png[/img]
- Players could notice that the dog very successfully could block other 
characters in the rooms, thus spoiling the game to other players. But now, with the help of an effective lover’s kick, he can send a dog down, and calmly run out of the trap (not only wife should suffer).
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/3a640784a33e1ccb17eb8af62487773a0557fc19.png[/img]
- Husband realized that the "adult toy" of his wife could be used to punish cheaters
- A car! Honestly, for a long time we argued about whether to introduce it into the game, but still decided. Why did we decide? Because it's fun! Run the second map, go out into the street, open the garage, and go! If you run away with a car, you will not even need your clothes - demolish the gate, and get away. Only neatly - The machine is very fragile, and can break, from a well-aimed shot from the shocker, for example.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/e5518d8843a2fac78dd24054f7b0657606e20607.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/8780ecc504e9eec3c80785d834958c0a4efb2e1c.png[/img]
- Also we had to remake the options menu, there are now more settings, you can change -  FOV, for example.
- To leave the house is no longer required to put clothes on
- The punch system of the husband is changed

Thank you all for your support and interest to our game, we will continue to make our game better!

notes.title: June update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
We are glad to inform you that soon we will release our new update, which contains new map, new 3D menu, and much more!

Work on the new map is in full swing, and soon all the owners of our game will be able to play on it!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/350da3f42b4d1890db4e3f1d35a1b2fc25096f48.jpg[/img]
The map will have a completely different lighting, there will be more places where you can hide, which further diversifies the gameplay part of the game.

The main menu will also be redesigned:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28135259/7efbd0a7b80f8b9511f76334b40e95b413a6bdd3.jpg[/img]


This menu is created so that you can customize the appearance of the characters.

Now we are trying to change the control system of the character to completely remove the camera shake.
Also in the game will be added a section, in which you can learn about the basics of  the game controls, as well as with the basic gameplay capabilities.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Catch a Lover is now available for purchase!

Our game is now available for purchase in Steam!

Thanks to all of you who followed the news about our game, who already had to watch numerous gameplay videos on YouTube from very talented guys.

I hope you all enjoy our game, in the coming days we will really need your support, your feedback and suggestions.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4027/4026141/profile/dog.gif[/img]
